title.zh: 【ZachXBT：某机构 97.3 万枚 MORPHO 被盗，价值约 230 万美元】
title.en: 【ZachXBT：某机构 97.3 万枚 MORPHO 被盗，价值约 230 万美元】

current_state.zh: ZachXBT reported that roughly 973,000 MORPHO (~$2.3M) was stolen from two institutional addresses through EIP-7702 account-delegation transactions, with the funds moved into Tornado Cash and one victim linked to a suspected Nima Capital address and an earlier ~$3.5M theft.
